description: React single-page app with Vite and TypeScript
create: npm create -y vite@latest {name} -- --template react-ts --no-interactive && cd {name} && npm install

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.sync: git switch main && git pull && node scripts/install-if-changed.mjs
scripts.sync:branch: git fetch origin && git merge --no-commit origin/main && node scripts/install-if-changed.mjs
